_about: Typed answers (keyboard) against a stored key: one table for diagnostic-service (tests/test_e7_keyboard_answers.py) and exam-service (to be connected in E-D). Decision 8 of wave E: the equivalent notations of one number (42/10 = 21/5 = 4,2) and of the empty set (нет корней = \varnothing) are accepted the same everywhere. 'accept' - typed text that must be graded correct for the key; 'reject' - must be graded wrong. 'contested' - cases where the services differ today ON PURPOSE or by an open owner decision: not part of the common contract, each service states its own verdict.

reject: нет корней и всё же есть

contested.note: exam-service grades an unreduced fraction as wrong unless the key itself is written that way (answer_utils._value_match_allowed, 18 bank tasks); decision 8 says 42/10 = 21/5 - to be settled in E-D
diag rounds to 10 digits, exam compares exact fractions
